digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter Cloud summary write and REST observation
propositions: One Cloud summary write invocation launches exactly one ACLI process with proper POSIX process-group and child cleanup.
Summary recovery REST request performs one primary-store observation with one attempt and no inner sleep, distinct from the shared three-attempt/2s-5s retry policy used by all other callers.

Per-call retry policy argument threads from _rest_urlopen_with_retry through _direct_rest_get to get_issue_by_rest, with only the summary-recovery call opting into one-attempt/no-sleep policy while all existing external callers retain default three-attempt/2s-5s behavior unchanged.
Permanent outcome classes (auth, TLS, permission, invalid) are classified separately from transient network/429/5xx outcomes; only transients return metadata to shared budget without local replay.

Every terminal or exhausted outcome emits exactly one completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 Unicode code points, with total log bounded at 1,024 Unicode code points and operation diagnostics at most eight entries.
